dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: The upper dorsal region displays a series of 'O' and 'C' shaped structures with jagged, high-contrast dark brown perimeters that transition sharply into light gray interior centers. The geometry is most defined in a central cluster of four prominent rings.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: A high density of small, asymmetrical low-intensity (dark brown) solid pixel clusters is distributed between the larger annuli. These blobs lack internal gradients and maintain consistent pixel concentration across their centroids.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of three prominent annuli on the upper mid-section form a scalene triangle. A separate group of four smaller annuli situated lower on the flank forms an elongated irregular quadrilateral.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Several thin, light-colored linear marks are visible on the lower right flank, oriented diagonally towards the flipper region, appearing as superficial epidermal abrasions.
other_distinctive_markers: A bright yellow identification tag is attached to the rear flipper, displaying the high-contrast black numeric digits '085'.
